title: GPOM Chorus: Skid Row Britain
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ chorus 1: Skid Row Britain (the poverty twin of Outbreak Night)
moodboard_intro: Chorus 1 goes back in between the intro's black and the bank downfall: 32 beats, 11 s, the drop the ear is waiting for. Outbreak Night was the end of humanity by violence; this is the end of humanity by poverty, the whole country on skid row. Two stills per idea, three lights to choose from (winter dusk, grey day, night). Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.

beats.name: The motorway is a town
beats.blurb: The biggest frame, on the kick (Kai put the airliner here in Outbreak Night): every lane of a motorway a camp.

beats.name: The queue
beats.blurb: A food queue miles long: over Westminster Bridge, up a terraced street, across a frozen field.

beats.name: The parks
beats.blurb: Hyde Park, the view from Primrose Hill, a village green: shanty towns with the skyline behind.

beats.name: Indoors
beats.blurb: A station concourse, the national stadium, a cathedral: dormitories.

beats.name: The estates
beats.blurb: Whole streets evicted: furniture on every lawn, every window shuttered.

beats.name: The high street
beats.blurb: Every shop shut, someone in every doorway; the shopping centre, the seaside.

beats.name: The fires
beats.blurb: Braziers and oil drums: the one warm colour, the twin of Outbreak Night's fire.

beats.name: Through the fence
beats.blurb: The machines still working, lit, nobody inside; the people outside the fence.

beats.name: Hands
beats.blurb: The twin of the cup: rain filling a paper cup, keys through a letterbox, coins counted short.

beats.name: Who it was for
beats.blurb: The towers lit and busy with nobody at a desk, above a country sleeping outside. Hands straight to the banks emptying.
